answer: The whisper counter is kept in ridge and horizon shows each reset. An copycat hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3352 identities would post 4844 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
